cryo.name: Cryo-Chamber
cryo.description: You wake up in a cold, dim room. Frost covers the walls. A faint humming sound vibrates through the floor.

hallway.name: Hallway
hallway.description: A long, sterile corridor. The lights flicker overhead, casting long, dancing shadows.

bridge.name: Bridge
bridge.description: The command center of the station. A massive viewport shows the swirling nebula outside. A computer console sits at the center.

engineering.name: Engineering
engineering.description: The heart of the ship. Huge pistons hiss and steam leaks from pipes. A large power lever stands in the center.

medbay.name: Medbay
medbay.description: A clean, white room with several empty surgical beds. The air smells of ozone and antiseptic.

keycard.name: Keycard
keycard.description: An electronic keycard with 'COMMAND' printed on it.

interactions.message: \n*CLUNK*\nYou pull the lever. Lights flicker across the station as power is restored!

*** SUCCESS! ***
You swipe the keycard through the powered console. The escape pod activates with a loud hiss!
You've escaped the Void Station. YOU WIN!
You use the O2-Tank. You feel a rush of fresh air. (+10 Oxygen)

intro:
You are the sole survivor of a disaster. Your goal is to reactivate the escape pod.
Warning: Your suit oxygen is limited. Every move counts.
